claims.text: Battery: 3 devices to look at. acme-macbook-1's battery is estimated to reach our service threshold around Jul 22. acme-thinkpad-8's battery is estimated to reach our service threshold between Jul 21 and Jul 22. acme-dell-9's battery is estimated to reach our service threshold around Jul 22.

Disk space: 2 devices to look at. acme-macbook-4 has had disk space under 10% free in 30 of 30 snapshots over the last 30 days, and still does (2.0% free). acme-thinkpad-8 began having disk space under 10% free inside the last 30 days and still does (15 of 30 snapshots; 2.6% free now).
Memory: 1 device to look at. acme-dell-9 has had memory use at or above 85% in 30 of 30 snapshots over the last 30 days, and still does (99.0% used).

Compliance: 4 devices to look at. acme-macbook-2's screen_lock check changed from pass to fail on 2026-05-22 and still fails. acme-thinkpad-8's screen_lock check changed from pass to fail on 2026-05-30 and still fails. acme-mac-5's screen_lock check changed from pass to fail on 2026-06-01 and still fails. acme-macbook-3's screen_lock check changed from pass to fail on 2026-06-01 and still fails.
